_doc: Dinacharya timeline blocks. offset = minutes after wake time. bedtime_offset = minutes before bedtime. use_bedtime = exactly at bedtime. detail can be a string (shared) or a per-dosha object. Templates use {wake_time},{bedtime},{focus_label},{season},{exercise_summary},{music_summary},{sleep_prep_summary}.

vata: Warm oil self-massage on feet before bed
Grounding yoga: child's pose, gentle forward folds
A consistent daily rhythm — same times every day
pitta: Cooling breathing: sheetali, or simple slow deep breathing
Yoga: gentle twists and forward folds
kapha: A change of scenery — avoid long couch time

vata: Keep meal, sleep and work times consistent
Stay warm; avoid prolonged wind and cold
Warm oil self-massage 1-2 times a week
pitta: Schedule downtime — you rarely notice you need it
Practise patience and taking breaks at work
kapha: Move every day — even 20 minutes counts

blocks.title: Wake up
blocks.detail: Wake at {wake_time}. Classical dinacharya recommends rising before sunrise — a consistent wake time is the anchor of the whole day.
blocks.reason: A fixed wake time stabilises your daily rhythm.

blocks.title: Hydrate & freshen up
blocks.detail: Drink a glass of warm water, brush your teeth, and use a tongue scraper if you have one.
blocks.reason: Warm water supports digestion; tongue cleaning is a classical dinacharya step.

blocks.title: Exercise / movement
blocks.reason: Chosen for your {focus_label} focus and adjusted for today's energy, activity, weather and heart-rate inputs.

blocks.title: Bath & get ready

detail.vata: Warm bath or shower; keep warm afterwards.
detail.pitta: Lukewarm to cool shower; avoid very hot water.
detail.kapha: Brisk, invigorating shower; keep it quick.

blocks.reason: Bathing after movement is a classical dinacharya step.

blocks.title: Breakfast

detail.vata: Warm oats porridge with dates and soaked almonds.
detail.pitta: Oats with milk and sweet fruit — do not skip it.
detail.kapha: Stewed apple with cinnamon or barley porridge — keep it light.

blocks.reason: Matched to your {focus_label} focus; see the Diet section for more options.

blocks.title: Focused work / study block

detail.vata: Do creative work first; take a short break every 30-40 minutes.
detail.pitta: Tackle demanding analytical work now, while focus is sharp.
detail.kapha: Start with one small, easy task to build momentum.

blocks.reason: Scheduled during the late-morning concentration peak.

blocks.title: Lunch (main meal)

detail.vata: Khichdi with ghee, or mung soup with rice — warm and grounding.
detail.pitta: Rice with a cooling vegetable curry and greens — make this your biggest meal.
detail.kapha: Barley or millet with steamed vegetables and a peppered soup — light but satisfying.

blocks.reason: Digestive strength is classically considered highest at midday.

blocks.title: Short walk (10-15 min)
blocks.detail: A gentle walk after lunch supports digestion — especially helpful for {focus_label} today.
blocks.reason: A light post-meal walk is a widely recommended habit.

blocks.title: Afternoon work / study

detail.vata: Routine, lighter tasks; avoid long unbroken screen sessions.
detail.pitta: Collaborative or planning tasks; stay hydrated.
detail.kapha: Movement-friendly tasks; stand up every hour.

blocks.reason: The second work block, paced to your dosha focus.

blocks.title: Afternoon reset (5-10 min)
blocks.detail: Stand, stretch, drink water, and take ten slow breaths.
blocks.reason: Beats the afternoon slump without caffeine.

blocks.title: Dinner (early & light)

detail.vata: Light vegetable soup or a small khichdi.
detail.kapha: A light soup; keep the portion small and finish early.

blocks.reason: A light, early dinner supports better sleep tonight.

blocks.title: Evening wind-down activity
blocks.detail: An easy walk, light chores, or family time. Avoid heated conversations and work email.
blocks.reason: Low-stimulation evenings prepare the body for sleep.

blocks.title: Relaxation & music
blocks.reason: Raga / calming music is your suggested evening practice.

blocks.title: Screen-free wind-down
blocks.reason: Screens and bright light delay sleep — start dimming things down now.

blocks.title: Sleep
blocks.detail: Lights out at {bedtime}. Aim for 7-9 hours.
blocks.reason: Sleep is the foundation of tomorrow's energy and balance.
